details:
ARK is an offline-first platform designed to help people become self-sufficient and prepared when internet, electricity, or essential services are unavailable.

The platform provides practical knowledge about essential skills, including growing food, finding safe water, building shelter, and navigating unfamiliar environments. Its offline map allows users to manually mark important resources, identify locations, and draw routes without GPS or internet access. A built-in compass provides directional guidance using supported mobile devices.

ARK's main benefit is making important knowledge accessible when people cannot rely on modern technology or connected services. Its intended impact is to improve emergency preparedness, encourage independence, and help people make better use of available resources.

We developed ARK using Base44 for app development, with AI assistance from ChatGPT for planning, writing, and development. The platform focuses on an offline-first approach, manual mapping, and mobile sensor capabilities.

What makes ARK creative is its combination of practical self-sufficiency education and offline navigation in one platform. We considered accessibility, simplicity, reliability, limited connectivity, and usability during emergencies.

Our long-term vision is to make essential knowledge accessible to everyone, on Earth and beyond, including future human settlements in space.
